test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

"The judge is hearing the final arguments."

options.text: The final arguments was being heard.
The final arguments are being heard by the judge.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The judge is hearing the final arguments."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the final arguments" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "is hearing" to "are being heard" (present continuous passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the judge."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The final arguments are being heard by the judge."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The final arguments were heard." – Incorrect tense (past simple passive).
 
• **Option 2: **"The final arguments has heard." – Grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Option 3: **"The final arguments was being heard." – Incorrect tense (past continuous passive).
